newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-C-C Amatil shares down after results.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-C-C Amatil shares down after results.

text.p: Shares in Coca-Cola Amatil Ltd fell over two percent on Monday following the release of its results for calendar 1996 after Friday's market close.
At 11.00 (0000 GMT), Coca Cola-Amatil shares were 33.7 cents or 2.47 percent lower at A$13.32 on turnover of 195,541 shares.
Gordon Furner, a dealer at brokers ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, said at current prices Coca-Cola Amatil shares were still at 50 times earnings, which is still expensive by Australian benchmarks.
"The local investment community is polarised by the company, there are some believers and some people just don't want to know about it," Furner told Reuters.
"It's hard to know where it is going to go from here, but it is unlikely it is going to go up."
Coca-Cola Amatil, which is about 36 percent owned by The Coca-Cola Co, reported a slight increase in net profit to A$142.1 million for the 1996 year, compared with A$138.6 million a year earlier.
